latest.title: Say Goodbye to Surprise Cloud Bills: A Deep Dive into AWS's New Official Open-Source Local Emulator
latest.description: Discover how AWS's official open-source local emulator lets you build, test, and run cloud services entirely offline with zero cost or credit cards required. Includes a hands-on walkthrough for S3, DynamoDB, and the AWS CLI.

latest.title: Building an Innovative Student Solution: Turning Ideas into Real-World Impact.
latest.description: Discover how a student-led idea can transform into a practical digital solution using technology, creativity, and innovation to solve real-world problems.

latest.title: Cut Your AWS Bill Without Sacrificing Performance: 5 FinOps Habits Every Builder Needs
latest.description: A hands-on FinOps checklist for AWS developers and architects—covering S3 storage tiering, idle NAT Gateways, right-sizing compute, CloudWatch log retention, and automated budget alerts.
latest.authorName: K k v v s Satyanarayana

latest.title: RAG – How AI Learns to Give Smarter and More Accurate Answers
latest.description: Discover how Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is making Generative AI smarter! Learn how AI retrieves information from external sources to generate more relevant and informative answers.

latest.title: Day 09: Docker Compose: Running Multi-Container Applications
latest.description: Declare a web service, a PostgreSQL database, a network and a named volume in one compose.yaml and start them with one command. Covers health-check-gated startup with depends_on and why it is not application readiness, what down and down -v remove, and where single-host Compose ends and an orchestrator begins.

latest.title: Building a Secure AWS Network: Understanding VPC Architecture, Private Subnets, NAT, Routing and Network Isolation
latest.description: What actually happens when an application communicates with the internet, AWS services, and a database inside the cloud? This article explores how Amazon VPC networking, subnet segmentation, route tables, NAT gateways, security groups, and VPC endpoints work together to build a secure and resilient cloud architecture.

latest.title: A duplicate-event checklist for a first AWS agent project
latest.description: A reading-based design exercise connecting emulator tests, idempotent tools, and least-privilege access. Includes concrete failure cases to consider before a small agent can change anything.

latest.title: From Manual Deployments to GitOps: Managing Kubernetes on AWS with Amazon EKS
latest.description: As applications grow, deploying and managing them manually becomes increasingly difficult. Development teams need a reliable way to deploy applications, maintain consistent environments, recover from failures, and track infrastructure changes.

latest.title: AWS Serverless Made Simple: From a Button Click to a Confirmation Email
latest.description: Learn how Lambda, SQS, and SES work together through a familiar student event example. Follow simple diagrams, try a short Lambda exercise, and discover why “request accepted” doesn’t always mean the work is finished.

trending.title: From a Shared Dream to All Five Regions of Brazil: My AWS Community Day Experience in Belém
trending.description: What began as a shared dream became a remarkable journey connecting AWS communities across all five regions of Brazil. Discover how collaboration, passion, and the power of community turned this vision into reality, culminating in an unforgettable experience in Belém.

trending.title: Migrate GPU Podcast rendering from EC2 to Serverless on Lambda Managed Instances (LMI) with 90 min async runs
trending.description: Our video podcast renders on a GPU once a week, and an AI agent runs it. What it took to move that to Lambda Managed Instances, cut the render from 5 hours to about 1, and keep the agent away from the GPU bill.

trending.title: We've never written code faster. Are we building better software?
trending.description: As AI accelerates software development, are we measuring productivity in the right way? Insights from AWS Community Summit Manchester on shifting engineering bottlenecks, evolving team structures and what the future holds for software engineering.

trending.title: Build an AI EC2 Troubleshooting Agent with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Step by Step
trending.description: Build EC2 Doctor: a Strands agent on AgentCore Runtime that inspects an instance, finds security and configuration problems, and suggests fix commands. Read-only IAM locked to one region, proven with the policy simulator, plus real traces, cost and cleanup.

trending.title: Deploying AWS Direct Connect (Part 1)
trending.description: Deploying AWS Direct Connect Part 1 covers the fundamentals and concepts of AWS Direct Connect, while Part 2 focuses on a practical, hands-on lab.

trending.title: How I Cut Hallucinations 99% on Amazon Bedrock
trending.description: My RAG AI document summarization agent on Amazon Bedrock, that summarizes a knowledge base of 1000+ documents, began hallucinating on long technical documents as it scaled. By grounding the model in source content with Bedrock Knowledge Bases and implementing chain-of-thought (CoT) fact verification before every summary, I cut hallucinations by 99% while keeping latency under three seconds.

trending.title: Build an Event-Driven AI Video Processing Platform on AWS with ECS Fargate, Step Functions and AppSync (Part 2 of 5)
trending.description: Part 2 of 5: build and push the FFmpeg container to Amazon ECR, create the ECS cluster and Fargate task definition, and add the Lambda functions that update job status and caption key frames with Amazon Nova.

trending.title: Build an Event-Driven AI Video Processing Platform on AWS with ECS Fargate, Step Functions and AppSync (Part 1 of 5)
trending.description: Part 1 of 5: architecture and setup for an event-driven AI video platform on AWS. Create the S3 bucket, DynamoDB table, SNS topic, SQS queues, and the AppSync API that pushes live progress.

trending.title: I Let Claude Code Create My AWS Account
trending.description: No credit card, no access keys, no IAM setup. With agentic account creation, one Claude Code prompt handles sign-up, setup, and deployment.

trending.title: Route 53 Can Finally Health-Check Your Private Endpoints. I Tested the Failover
trending.description: Route 53 Private Endpoint Health Checks bring native DNS failover to workloads on private IPs. I tested an EC2 lab with a 10-second check interval and a three-failure threshold, and confirmed failover to a standby within 36.2 seconds
